notable_absence.finding: The page names the plan gate for Health Advisor twice with different wording within one paragraph's neighborhood: the bullet list uses '(Developer Pro and Enterprise plans only)' and the prose below uses 'the **Developer Pro** or **Enterprise** plan' - consistent, but both use the short 'plan' form rather than 'Support Plan'/'Service Plan'. This is the same wording inconsistency already tracked in docs-issues/capella-support-plan-wording-inconsistency.json (Enterprise Support Plan vs Enterprise Service Plan vs bare Enterprise Plan) - recurrence, not a new issue.

cross_component_finding: This page cleanly confirms all three monitoring: concepts minted last round from reference/ pages (alert, event, health-advisor-report) and adds detail those pages omitted: the Health Advisor plan gate, and the exact event-to-alert escalation trigger stated even more directly than event-reference.json's version. It also reveals a piece of structure the reference pages didn't show: two independent, non-overlapping severity enums coexist in this feature area (event severity: Info/Warning/Critical vs Health Advisor severity: Good/Needs Review/Warning, already captured as monitoring:severity-level-enum) - the same word 'severity' names two different closed vocabularies depending on which sub-feature (events vs Health Advisor) is being described. Also surfaces monitoring:activity-log as a real, previously-unminted container concept distinct from the event/alert concepts it holds.
